column1: # The floor: what "the scan saw a tree" has to mean on this ladder.
# Two of common.tsv's standing rules are deliberately loose, because they are
# shared by every step from 2.4 to 4.0 and a threshold that is right for one
# rung is wrong for the next. These restate them for this codebase. They live
# in their own file rather than in a step's, because every step on the ladder
# wants the same two and a step that restated them would be a step that could
# quietly restate them differently.
# `include floor.tsv` after `include common.tsv`: an override replaces a rule
# in place and is an error if there is nothing to replace.
# The standing floor is "the scan saw a tree" -- 200 of 230 sources, loose
# enough that every step on the ladder can share it. At this step it has to be
# the exact count, because none of m1..m6 is answered by deleting a source file
# and a floor of 200 leaves thirty of them deletable for free: a candidate who
# could not make ProteinSequenceEncoder compile at 3.0 could delete it, lose the
# recordings that call it, and still clear the precondition. 230 is what the
# tree ships with, and a candidate who legitimately adds a file only goes up.
# controls/ast-229.tsv is one short of the floor rather than obviously empty.
# A fixture of three rows would keep failing if this threshold were quietly put
# back to 200, and the point of the counterexample is to notice exactly that.
override:ast-nonempty
column5: the tree is short of the 230 .java sources it shipped with; a source file was deleted rather than migrated

column1: # The scan is wider at this step than the standing rule assumes: --only carries
# com/databricks as well as edu/sdsc/mmtf, so m2-no-xml-in-jar can ask about a
# package the project does not own. An unqualified count of 150 classes would
# then be satisfied by the 158 databricks classes alone -- the precondition
# would be met by exactly the thing the step exists to remove. Restated on the
# project's own prefix, which is what it was always meant to mean.
override:classes-nonempty
column5: fewer than 150 of the project's own classes were compiled; the build did not run
